wordMeanings.description: معقول؛ عملي ومبني على تفكير سليم.

examples.context: وصف اختيار بأنه يستند إلى تفكير عملي سليم ومراعاة للواقع.

examples.en: Wear sensible shoes for the walk.

examples.en: The team proposed a sensible compromise.

examples.en: The guide offers sensible advice for first-time visitors.

examples.en: We have made a sensible use of the available space.

examples.en: The committee is considering a sensible alternative.

examples.en: The child gave a sensible answer.

examples.en: The organizer took a sensible approach to the delay.
